# cloptima_llm_gateway_tool_server (Data Source)

Reads an existing Cloptima LLM gateway tool server by ID or by name. Name matching ignores case.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a gateway tool server by name
data "cloptima_llm_gateway_tool_server" "catalog" {
  name = "Internal Catalog MCP Server"
}

output "tool_server_url" {
  value = data.cloptima_llm_gateway_tool_server.catalog.server_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Tool server ID. Specify either id or name.
- `name` (String) Tool server name. Specify either id or name.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_tool_names` (List of String) Allowed tool names on this server.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `customer_id` (String) Owning customer ID.
- `denied_tool_names` (List of String) Denied tool names on this server.
- `pending_approval_id` (String) Pending approval ID if activation is queued.
- `server_type` (String) Tool server type (e.g. mcp, openapi, function, custom).
- `server_url` (String) Tool server URL.
- `status` (String) Tool server status: active, disabled, or archived.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
